_comment: One machine's AI tools setting, the Modules page's Global configuration, under config/devices/<id>/. is_enabled says whether the AI tools of every account with a VS Code, code-server or CloudCLI instance on the machine use the hub's AI gateway; the agent points them at it with cc-switch run as each account, and points them back when it goes off. tool_configs is the desktop client's own shape: Claude Code's four slots, Codex's model and reasoning effort, Gemini's model; a slot left out takes the gateway's first model. Off and empty on a new machine.
